projects.smart-shift.title: Smart Shift Scheduler
projects.smart-shift.short: Workforce management SaaS with custom scheduling algorithm.
projects.smart-shift.long: Multi-tenant workforce SaaS using Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS). Engineered Stripe subscriptions (3 tiers, webhooks, feature-gating), 4-tier RBAC, and transactional emails via Resend. Drag-and-drop scheduling with optimistic updates, shift-generation algorithm, Recharts analytics, i18n, dark mode, and PWA. Lighthouse: 100/100/96.
